title: Was Doing, Did, Used To
label: ch:te-was-doing-did-used-to
canDo: I can say what happened in the plain past (veḷḷānu), set the scene with cēstunnappuḍu, and say what used to happen with cadivēvāḍini and uṇḍēdi.

payoff.summary: Complete TE-R316-the-past-three-ways: tell what happened, what was going on and what used to happen, in the plain past, -tunnappuḍu and -ēvāḍini.
